SELECT p.POST_ID, p.USER_ID, u.NICKNAME, p.TEAM_ID, t.TEAM_NAME, p.CATEGORY_ID, c.CATEGORY_TYPE, p.TITLE, p.VIEW_COUNT, p.LIKE_COUNT, p.CREATED_AT FROM POSTS p JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = p.USER_ID JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CATEGORY_ID = p.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN TEAMS t ON t.TEAM_ID = p.TEAM_ID WHERE p.IS_BLIND = 'N' AND p.CATEGORY_ID IN
#{categoryId}
AND p.TEAM_ID IS NULL
AND p.TEAM_ID IS NOT NULL
AND p.TEAM_ID = #{teamId}
AND LOWER(p.TITLE) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' ESCAPE '!'
ORDER BY
p.LIKE_COUNT DESC,
p.VIEW_COUNT DESC,
p.CREATED_AT DESC, p.POST_ID DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
